{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for the treatment arm
treatment_data = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the treatment arm
n_treatment = len(treatment_data)

# Check the number of responders in the treatment arm
n_responded = treatment_data['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_treatment

# Print results
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {n_treatment}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
